scope: Engine rope solver only. No level files were written by this task. Measurements use the frozen eight-rope Ascent snapshot retained in 2026-10-25-ascent-rbot-profile.json; live authoring continued during this work.
method: Separate, sequential runs; no concurrent builds, tests or other benchmarks. Browser reference rebuild replaces only the saved pre-change solver modules. All remaining engine modules are shared.
Hardware Chrome / Metal, 1280x800, DPR 1, normal 120 Hz accumulator with 50 ms frame-delta cap; no frame-step shortcut, offscreen culling or adaptive quality.

Uninstrumented frame times; separate sampling profiles for attribution. Diagnostic placements and scripted normal controller input are not a completed Ascent route. Stress is one 80-unit/sec impulse at 70 percent material distance on each rope.

Node exact-solver comparison hashes every tick of player/robot state, rope nodes including prior coordinates, pump input and bend points. Hash serialization is outside update timings. Coarser segment trajectories intentionally differ.

before.notes: Production code paths, readable bundle. Real RAF with 120 Hz accumulator and 50ms cap, no adaptive quality. Isolated diagnostic placements, not a completed route. Timings include warmup separately; sampling passes are excluded from timing claims.
